title: Deepen bee-wayfinding: interview craft, fact rule, spike rules, cross-skill pointers
action: GREEN phase of a TDD-for-skills edit (bee-writing-skills). The RED evidence is in CONTEXT.md ('What was found') — address EXACTLY those observed failures, nothing hypothetical. Three writes. (1) skills/bee-wayfinding/SKILL.md: add a compact 'Interview craft' section to the BODY (per-turn chat rules never live only in references): interviews run in ROUNDS over a question frontier — the frontier is every question askable now without guessing an unheard answer; ask the WHOLE frontier in one round, numbered, and EVERY question carries the agent's recommended answer beside it (recommending is not answering for the user — the user still picks; targets RED S1/S2 bare-question failures); a question depending on an answer still open this round waits for the next round; FACTS ARE THE AGENT'S JOB — a question needing a repo/environment fact gets a dispatched read (gather subagent or direct read), never a question to the user, and the rest of the frontier is asked while it runs (targets RED S2 'mental note' failure). Amend Session 1 step 2 so the breadth-first sweep is explicitly an interview WITH the user — rounds of frontier questions — and any agent-suspected fog line the user has not confirmed is marked (agent-suspected) in Not yet specified (targets RED S1 'tôi tự làm hết không hỏi gì thêm' monologue failure). Point the grilling ticket row at the Interview craft section plus bee-shaping's references/gray-area-probes.md and its Interview craft (cross-reference by skill and file name, never inline). Point the prototype row at the reference's new Spike rules. Keep the body tight — detail overflows to the reference; do not grow the body beyond what changes behavior. (2) skills/bee-wayfinding/references/wayfinding-reference.md: add 'Interview craft' (round mechanics restated with a short worked example — one round of 3 numbered questions with recommendations in the exact format the agent should emit, including the dependency rule and the fact-dispatch rule; plus the domain-modeling moves as one compact list: challenge a term that conflicts with an earlier pinned meaning, propose a canonical term for a fuzzy one, invent a concrete edge scenario to force precision, cross-check a user claim against the code and surface the contradiction) and 'Spike rules' for prototype tickets (the ticket's Question is stated at the top of the spike; runnable in one command or one double-click; no persistence, no polish, no tests; the full relevant state is shown after every action so the user sees what changed; several variants beat one polished take when the question is 'which shape'; on close the verdict and what it settled go into the ticket's Answer, and the spike stays under .bee/spikes/ as history). (3) skills/bee-wayfinding/CREATION-LOG.md: record the TDD pass — RED scenario summaries with the verbatim rationalizations quoted in CONTEXT.md, the GREEN content mapping each failure to the section that addresses it, and a note that GREEN re-verification runs orchestrator-side after this cell. Register: match the existing skill's voice (short declaratives, em-dash asides, no headers-for-show). Then run the full regen chain /home/thanhsmind/projects/goglbe/beehive/.bee/bin/bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write — REGEN_OBLIGATION for touching skills/) and commit once.
